library_preparation_preflight.summary: micronaut-data-connection-jdbc supplies the JDBC ConnectionOperations and DataSource-backed connection management. Its tests need a real DataSource and a Micronaut ApplicationContext, and the artifact's own dependencies don't provide either. The sibling test project micronaut-data-tx-jdbc in this repo uses the same extra dependencies. I did not resolve the 5.1.3 POM, so the dependency list is inferred from that sibling and not verified against the artifact.

deterministic_setup.reason: Provides the Hikari DataSource that Micronaut wires into the JDBC connection operations. This is the same version micronaut-data-tx-jdbc uses.
In-memory JDBC database, so no Docker is needed. Same version as the micronaut-data-tx-jdbc tests.
Starts an ApplicationContext for the tests via @MicronautTest.
Generates bean definitions for the test beans. Without it the context has no beans.
Assertion library used by the sibling Micronaut Data tests.

library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: Configure an H2 in-memory datasource through Micronaut properties, for example datasources.default.url=jdbc:h2:mem:testdb;DB_CLOSE_DELAY=-1, with the driver, username and password set. Use the ApplicationContext or @MicronautTest to obtain the JDBC ConnectionOperations<Connection> bean, and also exercise the DataSourceConnectionOperations path. Cover execute, executeRead, execute with a ConnectionDefinition, and nested/propagation behaviour, then run real SQL on the Connection. Follow the layout of tests/src/io.micronaut.data/micronaut-data-tx-jdbc, including the user-code-filter.json and the conditional agent mode in build.gradle. Do not use Docker. No environment variables or system properties are needed.
risks: The 5.1.3 POM was not resolved, so the dependency set may differ from what the artifact actually needs. Gradle and native-image verification should settle it.
The sibling's dependency versions may not match micronaut-data 5.1.3 exactly. Align them if resolution conflicts appear.
Hikari, H2 and the Micronaut context may need extra native reflection or resource metadata. That metadata should come from the agent run rather than being hand-written.
